When leaving our Copperfield subdivision and trying to see oncoming traffic on MD 180, there is a tree with limbs (located at 3246 Jefferson Pike) blocking the view when looking to the right as leaving our neighborhood.  I've emailed about this before and received a phone call from someone from the county stating that it was a state highway issue.  I contacted the state and was told that the tree wasn't planted in the state right of way, so it wasn't their issue. 
  
Ultimately, the limbs from this tree are BLOCKING the view from a county road (Copperfield Drive) and the limbs need to be trimmed back.  
I've witnessed more than one occasion this summer with cars attempting to pull onto MD180 from Copperfield Drive and pulling out in front of traffic because they cannot see oncoming traffic from the right due to this issue.  We have 125 homes in this subdivision with many homeowners questioning what can be done about this danger.  
  
Can the county please trim the tree branches so that we can safely see oncoming traffic when exiting our neighborhood? 
  
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
